query: INSERT INTO user_to_sign_up(email, password, first_name, last_name, otp_hash, otp_expiry) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET password = EXCLUDED.password, first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name, otp_hash = EXCLUDED.otp_hash, otp_expiry = EXCLUDED.otp_expiry WHERE EXCLUDED.otp_expiry > NOW();
